unit: 1.0 = one AssemblerComponent-type machine (incl. its power consumer) updated once per logic tick, vanilla game; costs are per entity per tick, independent of utilisation

unit_time_estimate_us.kind: multi-thread wall-clock per unit per tick, unknown CPU
unit_time_estimate_us.source: devlog 100K-matrix save 80 ms (likely old MT framework) / ~133k units, scaled by 1/1.9 (new MT) and 1/1.2 (0.10.34); conflicts with GPUOpen 6.8M/min TR PRO data point. Only relative weights matter for the MILP.

sample_and_hold.note: 1/UpdatePeriod (default 10); relative weights unchanged; incompatible with Weaver

weaver.idle_entities_cost: low but non-zero (power + neighbour checks each tick)
weaver.note: author's whole-game 3.0-3.5x vs pre-0.10.34 vanilla, remote planets only; mostly threading/data layout

assembling-machine-1.source: AssemblerComponent; tier only changes speed (Weaver OptimizedAssembler.cs)

matrix-lab.source: estimate: like assembler, main-thread (devlog), stacked-lab transfers

sorter-1.source: x = s/(m*k): sorters 1/6 of a 22 ms frame (GPUOpen devlog), k=3 per machine, machines 1/3-1/2 of frame

sorter-2.source: x = s/(m*k): sorters 1/6 of a 22 ms frame (GPUOpen devlog), k=3 per machine, machines 1/3-1/2 of frame

sorter-3.source: x = s/(m*k): sorters 1/6 of a 22 ms frame (GPUOpen devlog), k=3 per machine, machines 1/3-1/2 of frame

sorter-4.source: sorter estimate + stack gathering polls belt up to ~4 ticks (Weaver OptimizedInserter.cs; speed constant 存疑)

spray-coater.source: estimate: two belt queries per tick

planetary-logistics-station.source: estimate: InternalTickLocal each tick but dispatch likely staggered via timeGene (StationExecutor.cs passes time%60 to InternalTickRemote, 存疑); 笑笑 ep18 26:58 logistics 九牛一毛

interstellar-logistics-station.source: same + InternalTickRemote; vessels in flight extra

wind-turbine.source: estimate: per-generator power calc each tick (Weaver readme, DSPOptimizations planned list)

em-rail-ejector.source: estimate; sails cost extra (DSPOptimizations README: hidden ejected-sail impact reduced to ~15%, optimisation disabled in v1.1.19)

splitter.source: estimate: up to 4 in + 4 out path queries per tick (Weaver OptimizedSplitter.cs)

belt_path.source: per CargoPath per tick; jammed path cheap via persisted updateLen (Weaver OptimizedCargoPath.cs 1378/1390)

per_machine_terms.sorters_per_machine: sum over input/output ports of ceil(port_rate_per_machine / sorter_capacity); mixed-belt mode merges all inputs into one port. Direct insertion is a layout choice, not a per-recipe constant: model as a separate mode or ignore.

sorter_capacity_items_per_s.note: capped at belt max (Mk.III x4 stack = 120 items/s); sorter's own capacity from calculators-survey.md 2.1.2 is 存疑. Result: k_r = port count in practice

spray_coaters_per_machine.note: optional: 1 coater per input belt shared by the machines on it

belt_item_cost_per_item_per_min.note: assumes full belts; underestimates low-flow items (exact: integer belts ceil(F/7200))

station_item_cost_per_item_per_min.charged: per station passed; a drone/vessel delivery passes 2 stations (t=2)
station_item_cost_per_item_per_min.source: 4 belts = 笑笑 ep19 42:37 PLS worst-case-distance capacity (not a cap); ILS throughput unknown (存疑)

notes: Cost is per entity, not per unit of work: idle or blocked entities cost the same in vanilla (sleep states are a Weaver addition; inferred from Weaver load/save code, not from a vanilla decompile).
Sorter state (waiting vs travelling) is second-order; sorter count is first-order.
Only relative weights matter for the MILP optimum; absolute ms conversion is ~10x uncertain.
Not modelled: Dyson swarm sails, Dark Fog combat, local-planet rendering.
All coefficients except the assembler-class baseline are estimates; calibrate in sandbox (belts and sorters share one performance-panel category: isolate by layout).
